comment: What the decide job of release.yml waits to see green on a commit before it cuts a patch tag.
The GitHub ruleset (main-protection) is the only required list for merges; no job or test
compares the two, so keep this list to the checks a patch should wait for.
integration_id 15368 is GitHub Actions: it pins each context to check runs produced
by Actions, so a check run with the same name from any other app does not satisfy it.
scope: 'push' means the check runs on main commits and a patch
waits for it to be green on the exact commit.
